evidence.reason: The asserted defect is the missing backtick alternative in the dist-reference regex. The current tip already contains the suggested fix: line 31 of scripts/lib/dist-tests.mjs reads `/\bdist(?:\/|['"`])/`, including the template-literal backtick, so `path.join(root, \`dist\`)` is now detected and the finding no longer applies. The change is captured by the dist-test routing commit 81edce03aad3029ef1a4a27081d101dbd53ce199.
